documentTitle: Wipro Telco Cloud Infrastructure Capability-Mapping Matrix on Google Cloud (GCP / GKE / GDC Edge)

tiers.STANDARD_GCP_GKE: Tier 1: Native Managed GCP / GKE Standard
tiers.SPECIALIZED_HW_GDC_BAREMETAL: Tier 3: Specialized Hardware / Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) Bare Metal
tiers.PHYSICAL_OEM_PARTNER_EDGE: Tier 4: Physical Telco Edge / OEM Partner Infrastructure

capabilities.workloadNeed: Bypass virtual switch (vSwitch) for sub-2ms latency in 5G UPF, Packet Core & high-PPS CNFs
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: GKE / GDC Bare Metal SR-IOV Network Device Plugin; Cloud C3/C4 gVNIC Tier-1 networking (up to 200 Gbps) for cloud-native equivalent
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: True PCIe VF passthrough requires bare-metal/GDC Edge nodes with Intel E810 / NVIDIA ConnectX NICs; standard cloud VMs use gVNIC
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Position gVNIC Tier-1 on GCP Region for cloud UPF; position GDC Edge / Anthos Bare Metal with SR-IOV NICs for deterministic edge UPF

capabilities.workloadNeed: Kernel-bypass user-space packet processing for line-rate MPPS throughput
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: DPDK user-space containers running on GKE C3/C4 compute-optimized nodes (gVNIC PMD) or GDC Bare Metal (vfio-pci PMD) with HugePages & pinned CPUs
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Requires validated PMD drivers (gVNIC / ice / mlx5), pre-allocated HugePages, and whole-core CPU isolation
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Provide validated TELCO-HP-CNF & TELCO-UPF profiles bundling DPDK + HugePages + Static CPU Manager

capabilities.workloadNeed: Hardware-isolated Direct Memory Access (DMA) for safe VF assignment to user-space CNFs
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Enabled in host BIOS & kernel (intel_iommu=on iommu=pt) on GDC Bare Metal / qualified edge worker nodes
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Abstracted by hypervisor in public cloud VMs; directly controllable only on bare-metal / GDC Edge servers
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Enforce as a mandatory Day-0 node hardware qualification check in TELCO-HP-CNF and TELCO-UPF bare-metal profiles

capabilities.workloadNeed: Nanosecond-grade phase & time accuracy (±1.5 µs) for O-RAN 7.2x fronthaul & TDD slot sync
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Kubernetes linuxptp (ptp4l / phc2sys) DaemonSet operator managing PTP-capable NICs on GDC Edge / Bare Metal
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Requires physical PTP-capable NICs (e.g., Intel E810-XXVDA4T), T-BC/T-GM boundary clock switches, and hardware timestamping
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Map strictly to TELCO-vRAN distributed edge / bare-metal blueprint with certified timing NICs

capabilities.workloadNeed: Physical-layer frequency synchronization and primary Stratum-1 timing source at cell/DU sites
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Cloud-managed telemetry & alarm collection via Managed Prometheus; physical GNSS receiver / SyncE card on edge server
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Requires physical rooftop GNSS/GPS antenna feed, coax/timing card, and SyncE-capable TOR switch
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Position as a site-level physical OEM/facility prerequisite inside TELCO-vRAN and TELCO-EDGE profiles

capabilities.workloadNeed: Eliminate cross-socket QPI/UPI interconnect latency between CPU cores, RAM, and PCIe NICs
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Kubernetes Topology Manager (single-numa-node policy) + CPU Manager + Memory Manager on GKE dedicated node pools
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Best determinism achieved on C3/C4 dedicated nodes or bare metal where full socket/PCIe NUMA topology is exposed
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Standardize single-numa-node Topology Manager policy in TELCO-HP-CNF, TELCO-UPF, and TELCO-vRAN

capabilities.workloadNeed: Eliminate TLB cache misses for zero-copy DPDK packet ring buffers
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Supported on GKE Linux node pools (node-system-config hugepages-2Mi / hugepages-1Gi) and requested in Pod resources
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Must be pre-reserved on dedicated telco node pools (not shared with general BSS/IT microservices)
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Provision dedicated HugePages node pool via Terraform in TELCO-HP-CNF and TELCO-UPF recipes

capabilities.workloadNeed: Zero context-switching and zero noisy-neighbor jitter for real-time packet polling threads
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: GKE kubelet static CPU Manager policy + Guaranteed Pod QoS (integer CPU requests == limits) + node taints/affinities
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Requires dedicated telco worker pools with reserved system/kube CPUs
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Enforce Guaranteed QoS + static CPU Manager in all high-performance CNF and UPF RFS profiles

capabilities.workloadNeed: Prevent CPU sleep-state wake latency spikes and turbo-frequency jitter in 5G L1 / UPF
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Host BIOS performance profile (C-states disabled, P-state locked) & RT kernel on GDC Bare Metal / OEM servers
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Not user-modifiable on shared public cloud hypervisors; requires bare-metal or dedicated edge hardware
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Classify as bare-metal/edge BIOS profile tuning in TELCO-vRAN and carrier-grade edge UPF

capabilities.requirement: FEC / vRAN Accelerators (Intel vRAN Boost / ACC100)
capabilities.workloadNeed: Hardware offload of 5G NR Layer-1 LDPC Forward Error Correction within sub-millisecond symbol budgets
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Kubernetes SriovFecClusterConfig / Intel Device Plugins on GDC Edge / Bare Metal with 4th Gen Xeon vRAN Boost or ACC100
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Requires physical Intel Xeon Granite/Sapphire Rapids EE (vRAN Boost), ACC100, Qualcomm X100, or Marvell OCTEON cards
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Position exclusively in TELCO-vRAN O-DU edge profile via certified OEM server BOM

capabilities.workloadNeed: Offload GTP-U encapsulation/decapsulation, OVS/eBPF flow tables, and East-West firewalling from host x86 cores
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Google Titanium IPU offloads Andromeda VPC/gVNIC in GCP regions; NVIDIA BlueField-3 / Intel IPU device plugins at edge
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Custom programmable P4/DOCA pipelines require vendor DPU hardware on bare-metal/edge nodes
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Include optional SmartNIC/DPU acceleration track in TELCO-UPF for >100 Gbps edge user-plane sites

capabilities.requirement: IPSec, MACsec & TLS Crypto Offload (Intel QAT)
capabilities.workloadNeed: Line-rate N3/backhaul IPSec & fronthaul MACsec encryption without burning CNF vCPUs
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Google Cloud native encryption-in-transit + Cloud VPN/MACsec Cloud Interconnect; Intel QAT / DPU crypto plugin on bare metal
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Packet-level inline IPSec/MACsec wire offload at cell/edge sites requires Intel QAT or crypto-enabled SmartNIC
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Use GCP native Cloud Interconnect MACsec in region; add Intel QAT plugin in TELCO-UPF / TELCO-vRAN edge profiles

capabilities.workloadNeed: Strict traffic plane separation across OAM, 3GPP Signaling (N2/N4), Timing/Sync, and User Plane (N3/N6/SGi)
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: GKE Multi-Networking (Dataplane V2 secondary VPC NICs) & Multus CNI NetworkAttachmentDefinitions (net1..net4)
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: GKE Multi-Networking requires dedicated multi-VPC node pools and subnet planning
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Core architectural pillar already modeled in our Hybrid VNF/CNF & 5G UPF Terraform/K8s blueprints

capabilities.workloadNeed: High-capacity eCPRI fronthaul, F1 midhaul, N3/N6 backhaul, and core data-network breakout
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: GCP Tier-1 Networking (up to 200 Gbps per C3/C4 VM) + Dedicated Cloud Interconnect (100G/400G ports)
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Physical QSFP28/QSFP-DD optical transceivers at far-edge depend on OEM server NIC & TOR switch
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Map regional 100G/200G workloads to GCP Tier-1 C3/C4; map cell-site 25G/100G optics to TELCO-EDGE

capabilities.workloadNeed: Extended temperature (-5°C to +55°C), seismic Zone-4, fire, and EMC resilience in Telco Central Offices
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) Edge / Anthos Bare Metal deployed on NEBS Level 3 certified OEM servers (Dell XR8000 / HPE DL110 / Nokia AirFrame)
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Purely physical hardware & enclosure certification — not a cloud software feature
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Capture as mandatory OEM hardware BOM attribute in TELCO-EDGE specification

capabilities.workloadNeed: Fit cramped cell-site cabinets and run directly off telecom battery plants (-48V DC)
capabilities.gcpGkeApproach: Managed remotely via Google Cloud Fleet (GKE Enterprise / GDC Connected) over OEM short-depth -48V DC servers
capabilities.dependencyOrLimitation: Requires purpose-built telco edge OEM hardware and site power/rack engineering
capabilities.recommendedPositioning: Bundle with NEBS Level 3 inside TELCO-EDGE profile with Dell/HPE/Supermicro partner reference BOM
